Question
========
What will the following code do?

```{r output, eval = FALSE, results = "asis"}
#| message: false

gss24 <- gss24 |> 
  mutate(status = case_when(
  income >= 100000 ~ "High",
  income > 50000 & income < 100000 ~ "Medium",
  TRUE ~ "Low"
))

```

Answerlist
----------

-   It creates a new column named `status` with 3 possible values.

-   It filters out rows where income is less than 50,000.

-   It replaces the numeric values in the income column with text labels.

-   It removes missing values from the income column.
